author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Providence City Council member Carmen Castillo has requested a recount in the Ward 9 Democratic primary after unofficial results showed a two-vote margin.

The Rhode Island Board of Elections’ preliminary count listed Juan Pichardo with 625 votes, or 50.08%, and Castillo with 623 votes, or 49.92%. The figures are unofficial and may be reviewed through the recount and certification process.

Castillo filed her application before the 4 p.m. deadline on the day after the primary, according to the report. The Board of Elections will determine whether the request qualifies under state recount rules and, if so, how the review will proceed.

The filing does not change the current unofficial totals or declare a winner. It begins an administrative process designed to examine ballots and tabulation in a contest separated by only two votes. Ward 9 voters and both campaigns will need to wait for the board’s decision and the completion of any authorized recount before the result is final.
dek: Unofficial results put Juan Pichardo ahead by two votes in the Democratic contest for the City Council seat.
headline: Carmen Castillo seeks recount in Providence Ward 9 primary
